plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: BioBridge uses your location to confirm you are inside your branch's geofence when you clock in or out.
plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: BioBridge shares your work location with your employer while you are signed in, so the office can see who is on site. This keeps running in the background until you sign out.

extra._comment: Base URL of the bridge. The login screen can override it at runtime (persisted in the session), so a changed host needs no rebuild.
extra._comment_mobileKey: Must match MOBILE_PUNCH_KEY on the server (default: biobridge-mobile).
extra._comment_handsFree: Hands-free punching is disabled: the employee clocks in/out with the button. Background location sharing still runs while signed in.
